But views.py:14 passes the hostname URL to requests.get, which resolves it again, and nothing pins the validated IP. allow_redirects=False (views.py:14) does not address DNS rebinding.
verdict.reason: The attacker controls the url query parameter (views.py:11) with no authentication, and is_safe_url (validators.py:14-17) checks one DNS resolution while requests.get (views.py:14) performs an independent second resolution with no IP pinning, so a rebinding record can pass the check and fetch an internal address, whose first 200 bytes are returned to the caller (views.py:14).
